text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 奶油长方手拿包。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: ONLY one cream rectangular evening clutch. Large centered standalone accessory product photograph, pure white background, soft shadows. The ENTIRE output must contain ONLY the named accessory, no dress, no clothing, no person, no mannequin, no other objects. Reference shows an outfit; do NOT recreate that outfit. Isolate and recreate only the named accessory with all of its straps or ends visible.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
